# <span id="aanchor450"></span> Assign Meters to Close Groups

Meter Close Group assignments take place in the Meter Editor, creating a new meter from Meter Quick Create, or in bulk from the Bulk Changes screen.

For the Close Groups option to be available, the close schedule type within the FLOWCAL Options screen must be set to "Close Group".

<div class="procedure">

To assign a meter to a close group from the Meter Editor:

1.  Go to **Setup** \> **Meter Editor**.
2.  Select a meter, and click **Edit**.
3.  Select a close group from the Close Groups drop-down on the General tab.
4.  Click **Save** to apply changes. The meter is assigned to the close group from 1/1972 through 12/2037 by default.
